Environment: JDK 21.0.2 (OpenJDK 64-Bit Server VM), Mac OS X aarch64.
Each library runs in its default configuration. ✓ = decoded, ✗ = threw (exception class shown),
⚠ = a surprising result: a null inside a non-null Kotlin property, silently lost or invented data, or an exception outside the library's documented
exception type (kson `JsonException`, kotlinx `SerializationException`, Moshi `JsonDataException`/`IOException`,
Gson `JsonParseException`, Jackson `JacksonException`).
